verdict.rationale: The OpenHands CLI is an interactive terminal session where you type natural-language tasks, press Esc to pause the running agent, and resume conversations. Goal-driven conversations add stop/resume controls. Together these imply you can pause and redirect a live session, but no evidence explicitly shows injecting follow-up steering instructions into an active run without restarting. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sending mid-run follow-up messages that steer the agent, documented behavior of how queued or injected instructions are handled, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: Type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback
It provides a rich, interactive experience directly in your terminal.
the user sets an objective, the agent keeps working toward it, and the UI can show progress with stop/resume controls
